$comment: One plain sentence per hook gate ID for the Hook Gates explorer. Hand-written from each gate's own messages; scripts/explorers/gate-index.test.ts fails when a gate has no entry, an entry has no gate, or an entry's kind differs from its call sites.

H-00.summary: A guard crashed while scanning the call, so the call is refused instead of passing through unscanned.

H-01.summary: No commit or push to main or master, whether by a refspec that targets either, a push of every ref or a bare push from either.

H-02.summary: No force-push: the shell gate refuses force flags and + refspecs, and the git backstop refuses a push that is not a fast-forward.

H-03.summary: No wildcard staging: name every file you stage.

H-05.summary: The audit logs are append-only: a command or edit that would truncate, overwrite or rewrite their lines is refused.

H-07.summary: A dependency manifest changed: have the dependency reviewer check it before you commit.

H-09.summary: You wrote a crypto or TLS pattern: run the crypto check now, because the commit blocks without a pass.

H-09b.summary: A commit that touches crypto or TLS lines needs a recorded security pass for that exact staged change, and binary content the scan cannot read needs an audited override instead.

H-10.summary: You wrote what looks like a hardcoded secret: run the secret check now, because the commit blocks without a pass.

H-10b.summary: A commit that adds secret-like lines needs a recorded security pass for that exact staged change.

H-11.summary: ADRs are written only through the adr command, with a fresh authoring marker, and are never deleted.

H-12.summary: The file you changed is in the governs list of an ADR that is not superseded or rejected: if your change contradicts it, reconcile it or record a new decision.

H-13.summary: Prose you wrote uses an em or en dash as a separator: restructure it before you commit.

H-14.summary: A commit that stages a database migration needs a recorded migration review for exactly those files.

H-15.summary: A CI/CD workflow changed: have the security reviewer check it before the merge.

H-16.summary: A deployment or infrastructure manifest changed: have the security reviewer check it before the merge.

H-17.summary: Authentication or authorization logic changed: have the security reviewer check it before the merge.

H-18.summary: A write, edit or shell command that could turn off or damage the activation switch in .codearbiter/CONTEXT.md is refused.

H-19.summary: A hand-written or edited gate-pass marker is refused: only the sanctioned recorders write them.

H-20.summary: No --no-verify on git commit or git push, and no -n on commit: those flags would skip the git backstop hooks.

H-21.summary: A write or edit whose targets cannot be guarded, file by file, is refused rather than let through.

H-22.summary: Protected project state changes only through its owning writer, or under a fresh marker where its policy allows.
